package generated

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/attr"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/types"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/types/basetypes"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-go/tftypes"
)

func nestedValue(t *testing.T, ty attr.Type, state string) attr.Value {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	if state != "known" {
		var raw any
		if state == "unknown" {
			raw = tftypes.UnknownValue
		}
		value, err := ty.ValueFromTerraform(ctx, tftypes.NewValue(ty.TerraformType(ctx), raw))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return value
	}
	var value attr.Value
	switch typed := ty.(type) {
	case attr.TypeWithAttributeTypes:
		attributes := map[string]attr.Value{}
		for key, child := range typed.AttributeTypes() {
			attributes[key] = nestedValue(t, child, "known")
		}
		value = types.ObjectValueMust(typed.AttributeTypes(), attributes)
	case basetypes.ListType:
		value = types.ListValueMust(typed.ElemType, []attr.Value{nestedValue(t, typed.ElemType, "known")})
	case basetypes.MapType:
		value = types.MapValueMust(typed.ElemType, map[string]attr.Value{"first": nestedValue(t, typed.ElemType, "known")})
	case basetypes.SetType:
		value = types.SetValueMust(typed.ElemType, []attr.Value{nestedValue(t, typed.ElemType, "known")})
	case basetypes.StringType:
		value = types.StringValue("parser")
	default:
		t.Fatalf("unsupported fixture type %T", ty)
	}
	raw, err := value.ToTerraformValue(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	custom, err := ty.ValueFromTerraform(ctx, raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return custom
}

func objectType(ty attr.Type) attr.Type {
	if collection, ok := ty.(attr.TypeWithElementType); ok {
		ty = collection.ElementType()
	}
	return ty
}

func objectFields(t *testing.T, ty attr.Type) map[string]attr.Type {
	t.Helper()
	ty = objectType(ty)
	object, ok := ty.(attr.TypeWithAttributeTypes)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("expected object type, got %T", ty)
	}
	return object.AttributeTypes()
}

func assertParserFields(t *testing.T, ty attr.Type) {
	t.Helper()
	fields := objectFields(t, ty)
	if _, ok := fields["field_parser_config"]; !ok {
		t.Fatal("parser branch lost field_parser_config")
	}
	if _, ok := fields["expression"]; ok {
		t.Fatal("parser branch incorrectly uses expression")
	}
	if len(fields) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected parser fields: %v", fields)
	}
}

func assertObjectRoundTrip(t *testing.T, parentType attr.Type, input basetypes.ObjectValue) {
	t.Helper()
	defer func() {
		if failure := recover(); failure != nil {
			t.Errorf("conversion panicked: %v", failure)
		}
	}()
	ctx := context.Background()
	raw, err := input.ToTerraformValue(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	parent, err := parentType.ValueFromTerraform(ctx, raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	output, diagnostics := parent.(basetypes.ObjectValuable).ToObjectValue(ctx)
	if diagnostics.HasError() {
		t.Fatal(diagnostics)
	}
	roundTrip, err := output.ToTerraformValue(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !raw.Equal(roundTrip) {
		t.Fatalf("conversion changed the value: %s != %s", raw, roundTrip)
	}
}

func testObjectRoundTrips(t *testing.T, parentType attr.Type) {
	t.Helper()
	fields := objectFields(t, parentType)
	for _, state := range []string{"known", "null", "unknown"} {
		t.Run(state, func(t *testing.T) {
			values := map[string]attr.Value{}
			for key, ty := range fields {
				values[key] = nestedValue(t, ty, state)
			}
			assertObjectRoundTrip(t, parentType, types.ObjectValueMust(fields, values))
		})
	}
	t.Run("null_object", func(t *testing.T) {
		assertObjectRoundTrip(t, parentType, types.ObjectNull(fields))
	})
	t.Run("unknown_object", func(t *testing.T) {
		assertObjectRoundTrip(t, parentType, types.ObjectUnknown(fields))
	})
}

func TestNestedTypeRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	parentType := SCHEMA(ctx).Attributes["b"].GetType()
	fields := objectFields(t, parentType)
	assertParserFields(t, fields["columns"])
	testObjectRoundTrips(t, parentType)
}

// BLOCK_TESTS

func TestBlockTypeRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	schema := SCHEMA(ctx)
	var blockType attr.Type
	if NESTED_BLOCK {
		blockType = objectFields(t, schema.Blocks["wrapper"].Type())["b_columns"]
	} else {
		blockType = schema.Blocks["b_columns"].Type()
	}
	fields := objectFields(t, blockType)
	if _, ok := fields["block_field"]; !ok || len(fields) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("fixed block lost its block_field shape: %v", fields)
	}
	testObjectRoundTrips(t, objectType(blockType))
	if NESTED_BLOCK {
		testObjectRoundTrips(t, objectType(schema.Blocks["wrapper"].Type()))
	}
}

func TestHolderTypeRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	holderType := objectType(SCHEMA(ctx).Blocks["holder"].Type())
	fields := objectFields(t, holderType)
	assertParserFields(t, fields["b_columns"])
	testObjectRoundTrips(t, holderType)
}

func TestAlternateTypeRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	alternateType := objectType(SCHEMA(ctx).Blocks["alternate"].Type())
	fields := objectFields(t, alternateType)
	childType := objectType(fields["b_columns"])
	childFields := objectFields(t, childType)
	if _, ok := childFields["alternate_field"]; !ok || len(childFields) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("alternate block uses the wrong shape: %v", childFields)
	}
	testObjectRoundTrips(t, childType)
	testObjectRoundTrips(t, alternateType)
}
